regime_interpretation.label: Risk-On with Fear (Wall of Worry)
regime_interpretation.description: Market fundamentals strongly support risk-on positioning (VIX at 15.48, credit spreads tight at 272 bps, equities at highs). However, retail sentiment is at extreme fear (20), creating a classic 'wall of worry' setup. This divergence often precedes continued upside as fearful investors eventually capitulate and buy.
regime_interpretation.historical_analog: Similar to Q4 2023 when fundamentals were strong but sentiment remained cautious after 2022 bear market.

adelaide_narrative.headline: Markets Climbing a Wall of Worry
adelaide_narrative.body: Market fundamentals remain strong with low volatility (VIX 15.48) and tight credit spreads (272 bps), suggesting institutions are comfortable taking risk. However, retail sentiment sits at Extreme Fear (20 on the Fear & Greed Index). This divergence - strong fundamentals with fearful sentiment - often creates buying opportunities as nervous investors eventually join the rally. Your strategy is well-positioned for current conditions. No changes recommended.
key_points: VIX at 15.48 indicates low market stress
Credit spreads at 272 bps show healthy risk appetite
Extreme Fear sentiment often precedes rallies
No action required - strategies positioned appropriately
